mapper.select: select a.id as `id`, a.title as `title`, a.summary as `summary`, a.content as `content`, c.id as `category_id`, a.status as `status`, a.thumbnail as `thumbnail`, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name SEPARATOR ',') AS `tags` from article as a left join article_tag as at on a.id = at.article_id left join tag as t on at.tag_id = t.id left join category as c on a.category_id = c.id where a.id = #{id} group by a.id
